description: Show one submission by its batch_id: state, URL counts, credits used and refunded, drip-feed progress, and the URLs the URL check skipped with the reason for each. No credits are spent. States: queued, processing, dripping (waiting for the next daily share), submitted, skipped (every URL was skipped by the URL check; credits refunded), failed (credits refunded).

batch_id.description: The submission ID (batch_id from submit_urls or list_batches).

include_urls.description: Also list every URL in the submission (up to 500).

name: get_batch
title: Get one submission
